decisions.reason: The 2020-2021 aviation collapse almost certainly left this narrow passenger app well short of aspiration, and reduced slack makes it a likely candidate for problemistic search and reallocation of resources.

PassBoard is a multi-model product line launched with a public announcement and sits at the core of the firm's innovation-led airport strategy, so the recovering demand for contactless passenger processing makes its results more likely to approach aspiration.
Pandemic-depressed results put this self-service check-in solution under pressure, but interest in touchless processing as air travel recovers gives management reason to carry it a little longer.
